set.body:
Replace the geomTile matrix path (48k Rect primitives and a value-dump description at 80 x 600) with a raster recipe and per-column scaling; expose incremental rebuild so one term edit recompiles only that term's columns.
Acceptance: 80 x 600 matrix renders well under 50 ms; SVG export size bounded; rebuild of one term measurably cheaper than a full build.

Consumer: PLS Neuro native model studio epic (see the PLS Neuro integration ticket that names this id). General capability; no application-specific branches.
PLS Neuro spec: docs/plans/2026-10-02-model-studio-spec.md and docs/design/model-studio/ (branch studio/model-authoring-hillclimb, f8d32f0).
set.title: Time-down, raster-backed, unpaged design-matrix recipe and term-level incremental rebuild
